newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira CEO sees profitability staying good.
newsitem.headline: Kemira CEO sees profitability staying good.

text.p: Kemira CEO Heimo Karinen on Monday declined to specify if remarks he made about Kemira's outlook for 1997 referred to similar profit growth or a similar profit as in 1996, but said profitability would continue good.
Karinen earlier told Reuters Financial Television that he expected 1997 to continue "on about the same levels", as 1996.

Asked subsequently by telephone to clarify this remark, Karinen said he would prefer not to be precise but said: "Kemira's profitability will continue on a good level. I also see a possibility for an improvement in profitability," he said.
"If the operating level remains the same, that could mean the net result would improve," he added.
Kemira's profit before extras and taxes in 1996 increased by over 18 percent.
